chapters.title: BUY-SIDE POOL
chapters.text: The push leaves a high at 26,142.25 that no bar since has traded above: DS Parallax marks buy-side liquidity there on the 15m panel, where buy stops rest above an unswept high.

chapters.title: BUY-SIDE SWEPT
chapters.text: Price runs the buy-side pool at 26,142.25 on the 15m panel and the bar closes back below it at 26,138.50, so DS Parallax ghosts the level: a dashed trace ending in an x at the sweep.

chapters.title: BUY-SIDE POOL
chapters.text: The sweep's own high, 26,160.50, is now the nearest unswept high: the 15m panel marks it as the next buy-side pool, above the ghost of the one just run.

chapters.title: SELL-SIDE POOL
chapters.text: The move away from the sweep leaves a low at 26,022.00 that no bar since has traded below: the 15m panel marks sell-side liquidity there, where sell stops rest below an unswept low.
